evidence.quote: Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist

observations.why: Universal mandate framing — 'every new hire completes' — enacts a rule imposed from above on all newcomers, performing authority-ranking rather than merely describing a process.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter

observations.why: Replacement framing positions the checklist against a prior system by temporal supersession — a proportionality move (new displaces old based on quarter-over-quarter currency) rather than hierarchy or reciprocity.
